title: Apply Area Concepts to Solve Problems

items.stem: What is the area of a rectangle with a length of 8 units and a width of 5 units?
A compound figure is made by attaching a 6-unit by 4-unit rectangle to a 6-unit by 3-unit rectangle along their 6-unit sides. What is the total area of the compound figure?
Which of the following statements are true about finding the area of compound figures? (Select ALL that apply)
choices: You can divide the figure into smaller rectangles to find the total area.
You should add the areas of all non-overlapping parts of the figure.
Subtracting the area of overlapping parts is never necessary.
The sum of the areas of the parts equals the area of the whole figure only if the parts do not overlap.

items.stem: A compound figure is made up of two rectangles joined side by side. One rectangle is 7 units long and 4 units wide, and the other is 3 units long and 4 units wide. Calculate the total area of the figure. Show or explain your work.
